content:
git worktree list --porcelain emits one attribute per line (worktree/HEAD/branch, plus boolean-only bare/detached, and locked/prunable with optional reason), blank line terminates each record. Confirmed by running it directly against PixelFirm and SyncSmith: output is 'worktree <path>
HEAD <sha>
branch refs/heads/<name>

' for a normal non-bare, non-detached worktree.
